environment.description: Windows 11, Python 3.x, docs-harness source checkout executing real harness.py CLI subprocesses against isolated temporary projects
environment.data_setup: Initialized temporary project via project init --apply --host skip with real live_e2e Acceptance JSON and committed runtime packet fixtures

flows.name: valid live_e2e acceptance and packet pass end-to-end
steps: create frozen live_e2e acceptance asset with pass_criteria and fail_criteria
run runtime check on linked committed packet with mock=false and changed deploy_ref
inspect exit code 0 and JSON passed payload
flows.expected: CLI returns exit code 0 with status passed, 2 flows checked, and 0 errors or warnings
flows.observed: live-valid.log recorded EXIT=0, status passed, flows=2, states=3, data=4, probes=2, iterations=2, defects=1 with zero errors

flows.name: live_e2e negative probes rejected with structured codes
steps: set mock=true on live_e2e packet and run runtime check
remove one criterion_id and reuse prior deploy_ref then run runtime check
tamper frozen acceptance pass_criteria and run runtime check
flows.expected: each bad packet returns exit code 2 naming runtime_live_e2e_mock_forbidden, runtime_live_e2e_criteria_uncovered, runtime_live_e2e_deploy_unchanged, and runtime_acceptance_fingerprint_invalid
flows.observed: bad-mock.log, bad-gap-deploy.log, and bad-tamper.log each returned EXIT=2 with the exact expected error codes and next_action

states.name: success
states.expected: valid live_e2e packet exits 0 with status passed
states.observed: live-valid.log exited 0 with status passed and root_kind committed

states.name: invalid_input
states.expected: mock=true, missing criterion_id, and unchanged deploy_ref packets exit 2
states.observed: bad-mock.log and bad-gap-deploy.log exited 2 and pinpointed environment.mock, flows, and iterations[1].deploy_ref

states.name: runtime_error
states.expected: tampered frozen acceptance asset fails with fingerprint mismatch exit 2
states.observed: bad-tamper.log exited 2 with code runtime_acceptance_fingerprint_invalid on acceptance_ref

data.input: frozen live_e2e acceptance with 2 local_runtime criteria and linked committed packet
data.expected: runtime check passes with zero errors
data.observed: live-valid.log returned EXIT=0 and status passed across both frozen criteria

data.input: flow omitting criterion_id for one of the frozen live_e2e criteria
data.expected: runtime check reports uncovered criterion id
data.observed: bad-gap-deploy.log reported runtime_live_e2e_criteria_uncovered naming missing criterion f2

data.input: environment.mock=true with mock_rationale and mock_limitations on live_e2e packet
data.expected: runtime check forbids mock even when rationale is filled
data.observed: bad-mock.log exited 2 with runtime_live_e2e_mock_forbidden on environment.mock

data.input: post-freeze single-field edit to acceptance pass_criteria without re-sealing
data.expected: runtime check detects SHA-256 fingerprint mismatch
data.observed: bad-tamper.log exited 2 with runtime_acceptance_fingerprint_invalid blocking weakened expectations

ui.reason: This task modifies CLI contracts and validators in scripts/; no web or desktop UI surface was added or modified

probes.name: mock escape hatch bypass attempt
probes.result: supplying full mock_rationale and mock_limitations still failed live_e2e check with exit 2 and runtime_live_e2e_mock_forbidden

probes.name: redeploy skip and expectation tampering probe
probes.result: reusing cli-build-1 after defect returned runtime_live_e2e_deploy_unchanged and hand-editing frozen pass_criteria returned runtime_acceptance_fingerprint_invalid

no_defect_rationale: Real CLI positive and adversarial probes (mock=true, uncovered criterion, unchanged deploy_ref, and tampered acceptance fingerprint) all returned the exact expected exit codes and error codes on the first run after unit test validation.
